outcome: Safety (perforation, irregular bleeding, unusual vaginal discharge, and infection)
cohort: 180 women who received a PPIUCD after vaginal or cesarean delivery at a tertiary care teaching institute
finding: PPIUCD insertion was associated with low complication rates overall, with no cases of perforation or pregnancy reported; however, spontaneous expulsions were more common after vaginal insertions, and the incidence of undescended strings was high overall, with a significant difference between vaginal and cesarean insertions.
mod_finding: Spontaneous expulsions of PPIUCDs were significantly higher in vaginal insertions compared to cesarean insertions.
